dct_description_sm: Knowledge of seafloor coastal habitats is relatively limited for the Arctic, and very little information has been gathered on Labrador fjord marine ecosystems. This project seeks to better understand the nature and distribution of benthic habitats within northern Labrador fjords. Benthic habitat mapping is an accurate and efficient way to gather baseline information about substrate type, and associated biota. It is essential for development and implementation of resource management practices and conservation. This mapping study could be used to identify sensitive habitats as well as those important to fisheries, monitor habitats which may be susceptible to the impacts of climate change, and provide background information for the creation of policies regulating the harvesting of marine resources.
dct_title_s: Benthic Habitat Mapping in Nachvak and Saglek Fjords
